params.description: If present, wpArea is a form object name (Text); if omitted, wpArea is a 4D Write Pro object variable or field.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns a new range object (or a picture reference object, if an anchored image is selected) based upon the currently selected content in wpArea.
overloadMerges.note: Two fixes: (1) star_operator_dual_signature merge of both doc syntax lines into one overload, same convention as WA EXECUTE JAVASCRIPT FUNCTION / SET LIST ITEM PROPERTIES; (2) the first doc syntax line was wrapped in stray '<' '>' characters in the source ('<WP Selection range ( * ; wpArea : Text ) : Object>'), which made autoparse mis-derive the return type as the literal string 'Object>' -- restored to the correct concrete 'Object' return type here.

constraints: If no 4D Write Pro area is resolved from wpArea, an empty object is returned.
The command can only be used if wpArea is associated with a form object currently displayed in the current form/page.
